title: LILRA5(+) macrophages drive early oxidative stress surge in sepsis: a single-cell transcriptomic landscape with therapeutic implications.
authors: Xu, Peng; Li, Haoze; Tao, Zuo; Zhang, Zixuan; Wang, Xiaohuan; Zhang, Cheng
journal: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用单细胞转录组和机器学习分析脓毒症中氧化应激相关巨噬细胞亚群，核心是免疫细胞表型与疾病机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: In sepsis, oxidative stress (OS) triggers essential adaptive responses and emerging OS-related biomarkers show potential for enhancing sepsis diagnosis and therapy. METHODOLOGY: In this study, we used single-cell datasets and the OS gene set to identify immune cell types with the highest oxidative activity across different sepsis states. Differential expression genes (DEG) between "high state" cells and "low state" cells were screened. High-dimensional weighted gene co-expression network analysis (hdWGCNA), combined with multiple machine learning methods, was used for the selection of hub genes. Expressions of hub genes were then validated. Cell-cell communication and transcription factor analysis were performed later. Real-time quantitative reverse transcription (qRT-PCR) and Western blotting validated expression of LILRA5 in both the cecal ligation and puncture (CLP) model and the lipopolysaccharide-induced sepsis model. Reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels were also detected in THP-1 cells after silencing LILRA5. RESULTS: In the early stages of sepsis, oxidative activity reaches its peak, with macrophages displaying the highest OS among all cell types. Through the application of the "Quartile method", all cells were clustered into three states based on OS activity (low, medium, and high). LILRA5, MGST1, PLBD1, and S100A9 were selected as hub genes and significantly upregulated in sepsis. LILRA5 was predominantly expressed in macrophages and was highly expressed in the early stage of macrophage. Specifically, LILRA5(+) macrophages exhibit the strongest OS. LILRA5 showed a higher expression in both mouse sepsis models and the THP-1 cell after lipopolysaccharide stimulation. Silencing LILRA5 resulted in a significant reduction of ROS in THP-1 cells. CONCLUSION: In conclusion, our study has mapped the landscape of OS dynamics in sepsis and found that LILRA5(+) macrophages in the early stage of sepsis exhibit the highest OS. LILRA5 emerges as a promising gene for modulating macrophage-mediated OS in sepsis.
abstract_zh: 背景：在脓毒症中，氧化应激（OS）触发必要的适应性反应，新兴的OS相关生物标志物显示出增强脓毒症诊断和治疗的潜力。方法：在本研究中，我们利用单细胞数据集和OS基因集，识别了不同脓毒症状态下氧化活性最高的免疫细胞类型。筛选了“高状态”细胞与“低状态”细胞之间的差异表达基因（DEG）。采用高维加权基因共表达网络分析（hdWGCNA），结合多种机器学习方法，用于核心基因的选择。随后验证了核心基因的表达。之后进行了细胞间通讯和转录因子分析。实时定量逆转录（qRT-PCR）和Western blotting验证了LILRA5在盲肠结扎穿刺（CLP）模型和脂多糖诱导的脓毒症模型中的表达。在THP-1细胞中沉默LILRA5后，还检测了活性氧（ROS）水平。结果：在脓毒症早期，氧化活性达到峰值，其中巨噬细胞在所有细胞类型中表现出最高的OS。通过应用“四分位法”，所有细胞根据OS活性被聚类为三种状态（低、中、高）。LILRA5、MGST1、PLBD1和S100A9被选为核心基因，并在脓毒症中显著上调。LILRA5主要在巨噬细胞中表达，并在巨噬细胞早期阶段高表达。具体而言，LILRA5(+)巨噬细胞表现出最强的OS。LILRA5在两种小鼠脓毒症模型和脂多糖刺激后的THP-1细胞中均表现出较高表达。沉默LILRA5导致THP-1细胞中ROS显著减少。结论：总之，我们的研究描绘了脓毒症中OS动态变化的图谱，并发现脓毒症早期LILRA5(+)巨噬细胞表现出最高的OS。LILRA5成为调节脓毒症中巨噬细胞介导OS的有前景的基因。
